fields.description: Master switch. When off, no messages are sent or auto-replied.
fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Integration

fields.description: Host that handles sending. WaClient serves /send from here.
fields.label: Send API Base URL

fields.description: Host that handles instance management: status, info, and webhook registration. WaClient serves these from a different domain to sending.
fields.label: Instance API Base URL

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the API before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Each row is a connected WhatsApp number (a WaClient instance). Mark one as default.
fields.label: WhatsApp Accounts

fields.description: Dialling code used for local numbers, digits only (for example 254 for Kenya).
fields.label: Default Country Code

fields.description: Treat numbers starting with 0, or shorter than 10 digits, as local and prefix them with the default country code.
fields.label: Normalise Local Numbers

fields.description: Accept inbound messages and delivery receipts from WaClient.
fields.label: Enable Incoming Webhook

fields.description: Public HTTPS base URL of this site, e.g. https://erp.example.com or a tunnel URL. Leave blank to auto-detect. Set this when the site is behind a proxy or tunnel, because auto-detection returns a local address when the webhook is registered from the console.
fields.label: Public Base URL

fields.description: Register this URL with WaClient. Use the button above to do it automatically.
fields.label: Webhook Endpoint

fields.description: Reject webhook calls that do not present the token below. Recommended.
fields.label: Verify Webhook Token

fields.description: Shared secret sent as the token query parameter or the X-Webhook-Token header.
fields.label: Webhook Token
Webhook Help
fields.options: WaClient posts every inbound message and status update to the endpoint above. Auto replies only run for inbound messages received through this webhook.

fields.description: Run the WhatsApp Auto Reply rules against every inbound message.
fields.label: Enable Automated Replies

fields.description: Off by default so the bot stays quiet in group chats.
fields.label: Reply in Group Chats

fields.description: How long a contact stays in a conversation step before the flow resets.
fields.label: Conversation Timeout (minutes)
Excluded Help
fields.options: Messages from these numbers are still logged, but no rule, fallback, or AI reply is ever sent to them. Use this for family, colleagues, and anyone else you message from this number personally.

fields.description: Send a catch-all reply when no rule matches the message.
fields.label: Send Fallback Reply

fields.description: Outside these hours, rules marked Business Hours Only are skipped and the message below is sent instead.
fields.label: Restrict to Business Hours

fields.description: Comma separated three letter days, for example Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri.
fields.label: Working Days

fields.description: Let an AI model write replies using the business context below.
fields.label: Enable AI Replies

fields.description: Hand the message to the AI when no keyword rule matches. Turn this off to use AI only from rules with reply type AI.
fields.label: Use AI When No Rule Matches

fields.description: For example gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, or claude-sonnet-5.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Leave blank to use the provider default. Set this only for a proxy or a self-hosted gateway.
fields.label: API Base URL Override

fields.description: The single most important setting for reply quality. Describe what you sell, your prices, hours, location, delivery terms, and anything the AI must never promise. The AI answers only from this.
fields.label: What the AI Should Know

fields.description: Extra instructions on tone and behaviour, added to the built-in prompt. Leave blank for the default.
fields.label: Additional Instructions

fields.description: Feed recorded corrections into every AI reply so past mistakes are not repeated. Manage them in the WhatsApp AI Correction list.
fields.label: Apply Recorded Corrections

fields.description: How many corrections to include at most. The lowest priority numbers win when there are more than this. Each one costs tokens on every reply.
fields.label: Maximum Corrections Per Reply

fields.description: How many earlier messages from this chat to send as context. Higher means better continuity and a larger bill.
fields.label: Conversation History Depth

fields.description: Lower is more consistent and factual. 0.2 to 0.5 suits support.
fields.label: Temperature

fields.description: Replies longer than this are trimmed. WhatsApp messages should stay short.
fields.label: Max Reply Characters

fields.description: Ask the AI to judge whether each conversation is a real buying enquiry or just casual chat, and record it on the contact.
fields.label: Qualify Leads

fields.description: Contacts scoring at or above this are marked as a Prospect. 0 to 100.
fields.label: Prospect Score Threshold

fields.description: When the AI decides it cannot help, flag the contact for a human and send the handoff message.
fields.label: Escalate to a Human

fields.default: Let me get a colleague to help with this — someone will reply shortly.
fields.label: Handoff Message

fields.description: Create a Lead the first time the AI scores a contact above the prospect threshold. Later messages update that same Lead rather than creating another.
fields.label: Create a Lead for Prospects

fields.description: Who the new Lead is assigned to. Leave blank to use the system default.
fields.label: Lead Owner

fields.description: Stamped on the Lead so WhatsApp enquiries can be reported on separately.
fields.label: Lead Source
Lead Help
fields.options: Requires ERPNext. The contact's WhatsApp number becomes the Lead's mobile number, and the AI summary is added as a note, so nothing is lost when a human picks the conversation up.

fields.description: Store every inbound message as a WhatsApp Chat Message record.
fields.label: Log Incoming Messages

fields.description: Store every outbound message, including automated replies.
fields.label: Log Outgoing Messages

fields.description: Keep the full webhook JSON on each message. Useful while setting up, noisy afterwards.
fields.label: Store Raw Payload

fields.description: Message logs older than this are deleted daily. Set to 0 to keep them forever.
fields.label: Delete Logs After (days)
